en: Good morning! I'm Monica of Monday. Monday is the start of the week, and the start of my brothers' and sisters' days!
A Pokémon that holds a Sharp Beak hits harder with Flying-type moves. Have a happy Monday!
There are seven of us, one for each day. Have you met the others? They're all over Johto.
Today isn't Monday? Oh dear, I must have lost track of the week. Monday is my day!
